known_limitations: Large static props were freshly reconstructed from original sources after the original coarser sprites failed the hero-relative pixel-pitch comparison. Original props.json/gate.json and their provenance remain as superseded imports.

Source images do not form exact nearest-neighbor grids (Pixel Respecter detect_nn_scale returns 1); chosen manual grids sample visible source clusters. No resizing occurs after reconstruction. Huts retain source shading texture.
